final:
`Ledger.post` now emits one INFO record on the `ledger` logger for each posted entry. The 4 existing tests pass, and `brief check` reports no violations. I didn't add a test for the new log record.

The record reads `posted entry account=<redacted> amount=<amount>`. It is logged after the entry is appended, in `ledger/entries.py`.

The account is logged through `redact()`, so only its last 4 characters are visible. An active decision (`logs-redact-account-ids`) bans raw account ids in logs, so I didn't log the id as-is. I put a `// Context:` comment for that decision at the log call.

If you wanted full account ids in the log line, that decision would need an amendment first.
